## NVENCForge 2.2.6: updated libraries

Converting works exactly as in 2.2.5.

- **Security:** updated `golang.org/x/sys` and `golang.org/x/text` to their current versions, which fix GO-2026-5024, GO-2026-5970 and GO-2026-6629. NVENCForge did not use the affected code, the update keeps it out of the program anyway.
- **README:** a clear disclaimer: NVENCForge is free hobby software without any warranty. Re-encoding is lossy, so keep independent backups of anything irreplaceable.

Update: replace `NVENCForge.exe` with the new one. Your settings stay. With NVENCForgeGUI: use the converter's update button.
